question.text: Net Exposure in NIFTY Options after offsetting (Put premium Rs. 85.5 lakh − Call premium Rs. 49.5 lakh)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Net = 85,50,000 − 49,50,000 = Rs. 36,00,000. The Trap: Other options show unadjusted values. Cross-Exam Context: Illustrates opposite-position offsetting per Example 4. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Offsetting reduces total exposure but investors should see both sides — present both gross and net.
